end.summary:
Discussed how family members care for one another.
Practised sharing household work and care tasks.
Trisha repeatedly assigned cooking and cleaning mainly to mothers and girls.
Trisha mentioned that Papa sometimes makes eggs and suggested shared contributions.
Teach-back was not passed; the misconception was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised why sharing household work helps everyone and that any family member can help. Trisha gave examples of bringing medicine, sitting nearby, and bringing food, and noted that Papa sometimes makes eggs. Trisha still linked cooking and cleaning mostly with mothers and girls; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to match different household tasks with every family member, including themself, and discuss how sharing prevents one person from becoming too tired.
